Signs and symptoms (test document)

TEST FIXTURE written for automated tests. It is not official text from any health organization.

When symptoms start

In this test document, symptoms appear between 2 and 21 days after contact with the virus, most often after 8 to 10 days.

Early symptoms

  • Fever and chills that start suddenly.
  • Severe headache, muscle pain and weakness.
  • Sore throat and loss of appetite.

Later symptoms

Later the person may have vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach pain and unexplained bleeding or bruising.

A person cannot pass the virus to others before symptoms begin.
